notes: Read-only parse entire R4P2 Astra service journal and extract the latest USAGE_LIMIT records with attempt/timestamp/retry_at/checkpoint. No service/model invocation.

operations.content:
import subprocess,re,json
unit="prediction-a2z-v4-model@A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261007-R4P2.service"
p=subprocess.run(["journalctl","--user","-u",unit,"--no-pager"],capture_output=True,text=True)
txt=(p.stdout or "")+"\n"+(p.stderr or "")
task="A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261007-R4P2"
rows=[]
for line in txt.splitlines():
    if task not in line or "USAGE_LIMIT" not in line:
        continue
    rec={"line":line[-2200:]}
    for key,pat in {
        "attempt":r'"attempt"\s*:\s*(\d+)',
        "timestamp":r'"timestamp"\s*:\s*([0-9.]+)',
        "retry_at":r'"retry_at"\s*:\s*([0-9.]+)',
        "checkpoint":r'"checkpoint"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"',
        "next_action":r'"next_action"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"'
    }.items():
        m=re.search(pat,line)
        if m:
            rec[key]=int(m.group(1)) if key=="attempt" else (float(m.group(1)) if key in ("timestamp","retry_at") else m.group(1))
    rows.append(rec)
rows.sort(key=lambda r:(r.get("timestamp",-1),r.get("attempt",-1)))
latest=rows[-12:]
print("ERROR_CLASS=R4P2_ASTRA_LATEST_RETRY",flush=True)
print("ERROR="+json.dumps(latest,separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=True),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(1)
